<div class="wrap">
  <h1>Billings and coverage</h1>
  <p class="sub">Implied billings = TTM revenue + change in deferred revenue. Coverage years = RPO / TTM revenue. Billings stay blank unless both TTM revenue and a deferred change exist. No invented ARR or 8-K cRPO.</p>
  <div class="kpis" id="kpis"></div>
  <input id="q" placeholder="filter ticker or sector" autocomplete="off">
  <div id="board"><div class="loading">Loading backlog and forward-orders feeds.</div></div>
  <div class="foot"><b>Built for:</b> turning a booked order book into a next-year sales path.<br>
  <b>Data:</b> /data/backlog.json (RPO, deferred, deferred YoY) and /data/forward-orders.json (dated revenue history + book-to-bill when tagged).<br>
  <b>Formulas:</b> TTM = last four quarterly revenue points when the gap is 50-160 days; coverage years = RPO / TTM; billings = TTM + (deferred - deferred / (1 + deferred_yoy/100)) only when TTM, deferred, and deferred_yoy are all present. Empty cells mean the tag was missing. Research, not advice.</div>
</div>
<script src="/jh-growth-stack.js"></script>
<script>
var SORT="coverage_yrs", DIR=-1, ROWS=[];
function show(){
  var api=window.jhGrowthStack; if(!api) return;
  var q=(document.getElementById("q").value||"").toUpperCase();
  var list=ROWS.filter(function(r){return !q || (r.ticker+" "+(r.sector||"")).toUpperCase().indexOf(q)>=0;});
  list.sort(function(a,b){
    var av=a[SORT], bv=b[SORT];
    if(av==null && bv==null) return String(a.ticker).localeCompare(String(b.ticker));
    if(av==null) return 1; if(bv==null) return -1;
    if(typeof av==="number") return (av-bv)*DIR;
    return String(av).localeCompare(String(bv))*DIR;
  });
  var h='<table><thead><tr>';
  [["ticker","Ticker"],["sector","Sector"],["rpo","RPO"],["ttm_rev","TTM rev"],["billings","Billings"],["coverage_yrs","Coverage yrs"],["btb","Book-to-bill"],["deferred_yoy","Deferred YoY"],["rpo_yoy","RPO YoY"]].forEach(function(c){
    h+='<th class="'+(c[0]==="ticker"||c[0]==="sector"?"l":"")+'" data-k="'+c[0]+'">'+c[1]+"</th>";
  });
  h+="</tr></thead><tbody>";
  list.forEach(function(r){
    h+='<tr><td class="l"><span class="tk">'+api.esc(r.ticker)+"</span>"+(r.accelerating?'<span class="flag">ACCEL</span>':'')+"</td>";
    h+='<td class="l">'+api.esc(r.sector||"")+"</td>";
    h+="<td>"+api.esc(api.bn(r.rpo))+"</td>";
    h+="<td>"+api.esc(api.bn(r.ttm_rev))+"</td>";
    h+="<td>"+api.esc(api.bn(r.billings))+"</td>";
    h+="<td>"+(r.coverage_yrs==null?"":r.coverage_yrs.toFixed(2))+"</td>";
    h+='<td class="'+(r.btb>0?"pos":(r.btb<0?"neg":""))+'">'+api.esc(api.pct(r.btb))+"</td>";
    h+='<td class="'+(r.deferred_yoy>0?"pos":(r.deferred_yoy<0?"neg":""))+'">'+api.esc(api.pct(r.deferred_yoy))+"</td>";
    h+='<td class="'+(r.rpo_yoy>0?"pos":(r.rpo_yoy<0?"neg":""))+'">'+api.esc(api.pct(r.rpo_yoy))+"</td></tr>";
  });
  document.getElementById("board").innerHTML=h+"</tbody></table>";
  document.querySelectorAll("th[data-k]").forEach(function(th){
    th.onclick=function(){if(SORT===th.dataset.k)DIR=-DIR;else{SORT=th.dataset.k;DIR=-1;}show();};
  });
}
(async function(){
  var api=window.jhGrowthStack;
  if(!api){document.getElementById("board").innerHTML='<div class="loading">jh-growth-stack.js missing.</div>';return;}
  await api.boot();
  ROWS=api.list("billings");
  var withBill=ROWS.filter(function(r){return r.billings!=null;}).length;
  var withCov=ROWS.filter(function(r){return r.coverage_yrs!=null;}).length;
  document.getElementById("kpis").innerHTML='<span class="chip" data-realtime="1"><b>'+ROWS.length+"</b> names on book feeds</span>"
    +'<span class="chip" data-realtime="1"><b>'+withBill+"</b> with billings (TTM + deferred change)</span>"
    +'<span class="chip" data-realtime="1"><b>'+withCov+"</b> with coverage years</span>";
  document.getElementById("q").oninput=show;
  show();
})();
</script>
